extras: Desktop only. The copied note and its attachments are kept in the app's own local storage (IndexedDB) until the next copy operation. No network requests are made.
problem: Standard note copying only transfers text, leaving images and attachments behind and requiring manual link fixing when migrating notes between vaults.
summary: Note Courier allows users to copy and paste notes, including all embedded images and attachments, between different Obsidian vaults while maintaining link integrity.
